_about: One-off overrides for the daily social post, read by scripts/social_post.py (Ben, Nov. 25, 2026). 'skip': no social post that day. 'override': what to post instead and the earliest time to post it. 'weekly' is the standing plan (Ben, Nov. 27); 'facebook_links' controls links in Facebook captions.

weekly._about: Ben approved Nov. 27, 2026 after a best-practices review. Times are Central. 'publish' = post right away; 'schedule' = schedule it in Business Suite's composer for that time.

daily.what: Bay View in 60 seconds carousel (social_post.py <date>) plus Stories story-01.jpg and story-02.jpg, each with a link (Facebook: Add link)
daily.how: publish at the time (schedule it if the run finishes earlier)

wednesday.what: Business spotlight carousel (--spotlight), business @tagged in the caption

friday.what: On the market / open houses carousel (--realestate), only while a home or condo is live on the site

sunday.what: This week in Bay View Reel (scripts/social_reel.py <date>), upbeat instrumental added in the Reel composer's Audio step

_facebook_links_about: Meta limits many Pages to 2 link posts a month (Meta One). 'unknown' or 'limited': no links in Facebook captions or comments; readers use the website link in the Page intro. 'exempt' (only after Business Suite shows no limit for this Page): the run adds the link as the first comment on its own post (first_comment.txt). The daily run checks once and records the result here.

skip.2026-11-26: Thanksgiving: no social posts today. The Bulletin's introduction carousel is scheduled in Meta Business Suite for Fri. Nov. 27 at 7:00 a.m. so it is the account's first post. The website still publishes as usual.

2026-11-27.note: Post this AFTER the introduction carousel goes live at 7:00 a.m.. Today's one post is the weekend-picks carousel (it replaces both Thursday's skipped posts and today's daily carousel). If the day file has no 'weekend' field, the script falls back to the daily carousel.

_publisher_about: Nov. 27, 2026: 'business_suite' = the daily run posts through Business Suite in Ben's Chrome (old way). 'api' = the run only queues posts with scripts/social_queue.py and GitHub Actions publishes them through the Pages API (set once the FB_PAGE_ID / FB_PAGE_TOKEN secrets work). Reels stay in Business Suite either way for now.
